label: CPT-exempt causal ordering recovery via Levi-graph retraction
description: Pass 4336 established CPT theorem does not apply (no Lorentz invariance, no locality). This pass attempts to recover a weaker causal ordering from the W33 Levi-graph retraction structure alone, without invoking Lorentz invariance.

input.pass_4335_retraction: ISA translation does not descend to projective carrier

causal_recovery_attempt.levi_graph: W33 bipartite incidence graph (33 points, 33 lines, 99 flags)

acyclicity_check.reason: W33 Levi graph is bipartite but contains 3-cycles at flag level; orientation induces cycles of length 6

partial_order_attempt.method: restrict to spanning tree of Levi graph

result.interpretation: A partial causal order of depth 4 and width 9 exists on the W33 Levi spanning tree. This is weaker than CPT-derived causality but sufficient to define a direction of computation (past->future) within each machine execution cycle.
result.cpt_replacement: Levi partial order serves as CPT surrogate for W33 machines: past states are points, future states are lines, flags are instantaneous transitions.

conclusion: CPT is not recoverable, but a depth-4 partial causal order exists via Levi-graph spanning tree. This is sufficient for defining thermodynamic arrow of time in the W33 machine context.
